# CORE-SEC-02

**Is every connector that crosses a trust boundary authenticated and authorised?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [Core architecture lens](core.md) 0.6.0 |
| Area | SEC: Security architecture |
| Default severity | blocker |
| Decided by | A tool, by its rule |
| Reads | `connectors.authentication`, `connectors.authorisation`, `elements.trust_zone` |

## Rule

Every connector whose ends lie in different trust zones has authentication and authorisation other than none.

## Sources

- NIST SP 800-207, Zero Trust Architecture (2020) (`zt-800-207`)
- AWS Well-Architected Framework, Security Pillar (`wa-aws-sec`)
